en.title: Z
en.summary: The letter Z is the twenty-seventh letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name and sound
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /z/. It makes the sound /z/, as in the word (zi) /ˈzɛ.bre/, which means zebra. This letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say the sound
paragraphs: Bring your teeth close together. Place the tip of your tongue near the gum behind your top teeth. Push air through the narrow gap between your tongue and teeth. Make your vocal cords vibrate. You can touch your throat to feel a strong buzz.

sections.title: When to use this sound
paragraphs: The letter always sounds like /z/ in every position. You hear it at the start, in the middle, or at the end of a word. A clear example is (varză) /ˈvar.zə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: This letter sounds just like the letter z in the English word zoo. Do not turn it into an unvoiced sound like the s in sun. Keep your vocal cords buzzing from the start.
